description: Unify feature-flag variant evaluation orchestration across the flag-service preview path and the Rust SDK into a single pure stitchd-core entry point. Collapse the divergent percentage-hash schemas (PercentageTarget vs ContextHashSpec) into one canonical HashInputSpec end-to-end (Admin UI → REST → proto → PG → core → SDK). Bring the SDK to multi-context input so cross-context hashing (e.g. user.key + user.params.name + device.params.os + application.key) works from authoring UI through to in-process SDK evaluation. Close the SDK's default_rule_distribution feature gap as a side effect of unification.
